title: Rice MMKG: a Rice Multimodal Knowledge Graph
description: Rice MMKG is a knowledge graph for rice disease and pest diagnosis, populated from the Paddy Doctor image dataset. It links diseases, pests, pathogens, symptoms, environmental factors, growth stages, and management knowledge, and separates raw dataset annotation from domain-knowledge evidence. This is a minimal schema in which every class holds individuals and every asserted property holds assertions.
